name: Coin Change (Greedy)
description: Greedily selects the largest denomination coin at each step to minimize total coins. Works for standard currency systems (US, EU) but NOT all coin systems.
aim: Make change for target amount using fewest coins by always choosing the largest coin that fits.
howItWorks: Use as many of this coin as possible (target // coin)

realWorld: Vending machine change for canonical systems
whenToUse: Canonical coin systems where greedy works (1,5,10,25)
When DP is overkill for guaranteed-valid denominations
alternatives: Dynamic Programming — O(amount×n) — needed for arbitrary denominations

inputHint: The LAST number is the amount; the numbers before it are the coin denominations. Try 1, 3, 4, 6 to see greedy get it wrong.
